tuition.quote: Tuition Fees General information As of the winter semester 2013/14, no tuition fees are charged.
tuition.notes: Standing policy, no academic year printed for it, so the build keeps it stale ('the academic year is not stated'); LMU is not in STANDING_FEE_POLICIES. Separate, not tuition: the Studierendenwerk semester fee ('Each semester all students must pay the fees for the Studierendenwerk (Munich Student Union)'; the KB import gives 'Sommersemester 2026: Grundbeitrag 97,00 €'). Graduate/special programmes may carry separate fees (same page), not the Informatik bachelor. Bavaria's 2023 law (BayHIG) allows fees for non-EU students, but the page read states none are charged at LMU.
